name: Cricket
description: Cricket is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

content.text: Cricket is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

Country/Region of Origin: United Kingdom, South Africa, New Zealand. Played by British prisoners of war during WWII; still played in Britain and in different forms in South Africa and New Zealand.
Time Period: Early 1900s / WWII
Historical Development: Card simulation of cricket invented during WWII, taught to German camp guards.
Cultural Significance: Popular in Britain, South Africa, and New Zealand.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
